title: NEXUS: Neural Energy Fields for Physically Consistent Contact-Rich 3D Object Dynamics
abstract: arXiv:2606.15015v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Physics-grounded video generation requires controllable 3D object dynamics that remain physically consistent under contact, deformation, and external forcing. Existing trajectory-based methods often model isolated physical effects, making it difficult to compose conservative and non-conservative dynamics in contact-rich 3D scenes. We present NEXUS, a neural energy-field framework for contact-rich 3D object dynamics. NEXUS represents each object as a structural graph and constructs dynamic object-object and object-environment contact graphs. Inspired by Hamiltonian Neural Networks, NEXUS formulates motion through scalar energy and dissipation terms rather than directly predicting states or accelerations. translated_title: NEXUS：面向物理一致性的富接触三维物体动力学的神经能量场
translated_abstract: 基于物理的视频生成需要可控的三维物体动力学，使其在接触、形变和外力作用下保持物理一致性。现有的基于轨迹的方法通常只建模孤立的物理效应，难以在富接触的三维场景中组合保守与非保守动力学。我们提出了NEXUS，一个面向富接触三维物体动力学的神经能量场框架。NEXUS将每个物体表示为结构图，并构建动态的物体-物体和物体-环境接触图。受哈密顿神经网络的启发，NEXUS通过标量能量项和耗散项来表述运动，而不是直接预测状态或加速度。保守效应（包括重力和弹性形变）被组合为可加的能量项，而非保守效应（如阻尼和冲击引起的能量损失）则通过学习得到的瑞利式耗散进行建模。
tldr: NEXUS提出了一种神经能量场框架，通过将重力和弹性形变等保守效应组合为可加能量项、将阻尼和冲击能量损失等非保守效应建模为学习得到的瑞利式耗散，实现了物理一致的富接触三维物体动力学建模。
en_tdlr: NEXUS introduces a neural energy-field framework that achieves physically consistent contact-rich 3D object dynamics by composing conservative effects (gravity, elastic deformation) as additive energy terms and modeling non-conservative effects (damping, impact-induced energy loss) with learned Rayleigh-style dissipation.
